svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.title: Xbox Controller Input Domain

g.aria-label: text intro: Every input, and every state it can occupy - including the full directional and motion vocabulary.
g.text: Every input, and every state it can occupy - including the full directional and motion vocabulary.

g.aria-label: text section_2: 2. DIGITAL INPUTS - EDGE MODEL
text section_3: 3. ANALOG TRIGGERS - LT / RT
text trigger_intro: Raw travel, one unsigned byte per trigger. Both triggers are independent.
g.text: Raw travel, one unsigned byte per trigger. Both triggers are independent.

g.aria-label: text section_4: 4. STICK GEOMETRY - ZONES AND DIRECTIONS
text section_5: 5. MOTION GESTURES - PATHS THROUGH THE DIRECTIONS
g.text: 5. MOTION GESTURES - PATHS THROUGH THE DIRECTIONS

g.aria-label: text gesture_intro: Each gesture begins in a direction cell and follows an explicit lattice path.
g.text: Each gesture begins in a direction cell and follows an explicit lattice path.

g.aria-label: text section_6: 6. COMPLETE INPUT DOMAIN TABLE
box call_left_stick: LEFT STICK (LS) - analog X/Y; click = L3
g.text: LEFT STICK (LS) - analog X/Y; click = L3

g.aria-label: box call_dpad: D-PAD - four digital switches; 8-way by pairing
g.text: D-PAD - four digital switches; 8-way by pairing

g.aria-label: box call_face: FACE BUTTONS Y X B A - four independent digital inputs
g.text: FACE BUTTONS Y X B A - four independent digital inputs

g.aria-label: box call_right_stick: RIGHT STICK (RS) - analog X/Y; click = R3
g.text: RIGHT STICK (RS) - analog X/Y; click = R3

g.aria-label: box state_pressed: PRESSED - rising edge, true for 1 poll
g.text: PRESSED - rising edge, true for 1 poll

g.aria-label: box state_releasing: RELEASING - falling edge, 1 poll
box state_held: HELD - down, steady; repeat timer
Relationship edge_press, from state_up to state_pressed
Relationship edge_hold, from state_pressed to state_held
Relationship edge_release, from state_held to state_releasing
Relationship edge_reset, from state_releasing to state_up
box edge_note: All 16 digital inputs run this machine independently. PRESSED and RELEASING are true for exactly one poll; UP and HELD persist.
g.text: All 16 digital inputs run this machine independently. PRESSED and RELEASING are true for exactly one poll; UP

g.aria-label: box trigger_live: LIVE 30-255 - continuous analog travel
box trigger_threshold: A trigger has no rising or falling edge of its own. Input code derives PRESSED by comparing raw travel against a configurable threshold.
g.text: A trigger has no rising or falling edge of its own. Input code derives PRESSED by comparing raw travel against a

g.aria-label: box poll_contract: ONE POLL RETURNS ONE ROW: digital bits; D-pad switch bits; LT and RT from 0 to 255; LX, LY, RX and RY as signed 16-bit axes. Every change is measured against the prior sample.
g.text: ONE POLL RETURNS ONE ROW: digital bits; D-pad switch bits; LT and RT from 0 to 255; LX, LY, RX and RY as signed
16-bit axes. Every change is measured against the prior sample.

g.aria-label: text compass_legend: compass | numpad | degrees clockwise from N
g.text: compass | numpad | degrees clockwise from N

g.aria-label: box stick_note: Raw axes are signed 16-bit values with +Y up. Radial deadzones preserve direction and magnitude; every angle and magnitude between named directions exists.
g.text: Raw axes are signed 16-bit values with +Y up. Radial deadzones preserve direction and magnitude; every angle and

g.aria-label: text th_states: STATES IT CAN OCCUPY
text tr1a: A, B, X, Y
text tr1d: Four independent edge-state machines: UP / PRESSED / HELD / RELEASING.
g.text: Four independent edge-state machines: UP / PRESSED / HELD / RELEASING.

g.aria-label: text tr2d: Same four machine states; independent of analog trigger travel.
g.text: Same four machine states; independent of analog trigger travel.

g.aria-label: text tr3a: View, Menu, Guide, Share
text tr3d: Console and OS buttons; Share exists on Series X|S controllers.
g.text: Console and OS buttons; Share exists on Series X|S controllers.

g.aria-label: text tr4d: Fully independent; each stick can click at any deflection.
g.text: Fully independent; each stick can click at any deflection.

g.aria-label: text tr5a: D-Up, D-Down, D-Left, D-Right
text tr5d: Neutral, four cardinals, four diagonals; opposing pairs normally rejected.
g.text: Neutral, four cardinals, four diagonals; opposing pairs normally rejected.

g.aria-label: text tr6d: Continuous travel; PRESSED is derived from a configurable threshold.
g.text: Continuous travel; PRESSED is derived from a configurable threshold.

g.aria-label: text tr7a: LX, LY, RX, RY
text tr7d: Two independent signed planes; radial deadzones preserve angle and magnitude.
g.text: Two independent signed planes; radial deadzones preserve angle and magnitude.

g.aria-label: box configuration_note: EVERY CONFIGURATION, COUNTED HONESTLY. Multiply independent digital buttons, D-pad positions, trigger levels, and stick planes only when the hardware can truly occupy those states together.
g.text: EVERY CONFIGURATION, COUNTED HONESTLY. Multiply independent digital buttons, D-pad positions, trigger levels, and stick planes only when the hardware can truly occupy those states together.
